name: Cloud Live Technology Group Co.,Ltd.
summary: Cloud Live Technology Group Co.,Ltd. is a Chinese enterprise primarily engaged in the catering industry. Its operations also encompass the planning and execution of large-scale meal services, alongside the promotion and management of internet games. Established in 1999, the company maintains its headquarters in Beijing, China. It transitioned to its current name, Cloud Live Technology Group Co.,Ltd., in August 2014, having previously been known as Beijing Xiangeqing Co., Group Ltd.
